text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Government grants local government workers a 15.000 kwacha (about $11) across-the-board pay rise.
- President Frederick Chiluba warns diplomats against attending meetings without being briefed properly by him.
- Germany contributes $290.000 towards the support of thousands of Zairean refugees in the country.

- A Lusaka court throws out an application by editors of The Post, an independent daily, to suspend proceedings until an electoral petition against president Frederick Chiluba is disposed of. The editors are charged with defaming Chiluba.
- An opposition member of Parliament expresses concern at the number of unexplained deaths and telephone tappings in the country.
- Four top leaders of the peasant farmers association are locked up for stealing about 3.000 bags of fertiliser.
